create_action_executor: create an ActionExecutor module to predict dialogue actions and their attributes for SIMMC
run_action_forward_pass: run the forward pass of ActionExecutor to predict actions and compute action losses on a batch
build_action_classifier_network: build a classification network with two hidden layers for predicting actions or attributes
predict_action_attributes: predict action attributes using per-attribute classifiers conditioned on predicted actions
integrate_multimodal_state: integrate multimodal state from carousel or user memory embeddings into the action prediction pipeline
